data.title: Log Sanitizer
data.statement:
As a SecOps engineer, you must ensure that sensitive data never leaks into application logs.

For the purposes of this task, <<tokens>> are defined as being bounded by non-alphanumeric characters or the beginning or end of the line.

Inspect a stream of server log lines and sanitize all occurrences of the following two patterns, subject to the overlapping rule:

1. <<Credit card numbers>>
Exactly four consecutive tokens, each consisting of exactly 4 digits and joined by {{-}}, form a credit card number and should be replaced with {{[CARD_REDACTED]}}.

2. <<API token>>
A token {{token}} (case-sensitive), immediately followed by {{=}} and another token (the <<value>>) consisting of one or more alphanumeric characters, forms an API token. Redact the value token only, replacing it with {{[TOKEN_REDACTED]}}.

<<Overlapping rule>>
Overlapping occurrences of a single pattern should not be considered to fit the pattern and should remain unchanged. For example, this applies to:
• Five or more consecutive tokens, each consisting of exactly 4 digits and joined by {{-}}.
• {{token=}} appears consecutively two or more times.

If {{token=}} is immediately followed by a token consisting of exactly 4 digits, treat that 4-digit token as the API-token value. This takes precedence over any credit-card matching that might otherwise involve that token. Continue processing the remaining text after redacting that token.

All other log characters must remain untouched.

testCases.title: Test 1: Simple examples
testCases.testIn:
4
[SYSTEM] Server running on port 8080 with 0 errors.
[TRANSFER] Moved funds from 8291-3849-1029-4820 to 5731-4921-5829-1039 confirmed.
192.168.1.1 - GET /auth?token=abC123XyZ HTTP/1.1
2023-10-01 12:00:00 INFO: Session initiated, token=validToken123 login success
testCases.testOut:
[SYSTEM] Server running on port 8080 with 0 errors.
[TRANSFER] Moved funds from [CARD_REDACTED] to [CARD_REDACTED] confirmed.
192.168.1.1 - GET /auth?token=[TOKEN_REDACTED] HTTP/1.1
2023-10-01 12:00:00 INFO: Session initiated, token=[TOKEN_REDACTED] login success

testCases.title: Validator 1
testCases.testIn:
4
[INIT] September 7, 2026: system startup clean.
[SYNC] Pairing devices linked to 1029-3847-5610-2938 and 4756-1029-3847-5610 done.
10.0.0.5 - POST /refresh?token=SecretSession99 HTTP/2.0
[INFO] External API call with token=MySecret777 executed successfully
testCases.testOut:
[INIT] September 7, 2026: system startup clean.
[SYNC] Pairing devices linked to [CARD_REDACTED] and [CARD_REDACTED] done.
10.0.0.5 - POST /refresh?token=[TOKEN_REDACTED] HTTP/2.0
[INFO] External API call with token=[TOKEN_REDACTED] executed successfully

testCases.title: Test 2: Start and end of line
testCases.testIn:
2
1111-2222-3333-4444 is expired.
[PAYMENT] Successfully processed transaction with card 4928-1029-3847-5610
testCases.testOut:
[CARD_REDACTED] is expired.
[PAYMENT] Successfully processed transaction with card [CARD_REDACTED]

testCases.title: Validator 2
testCases.testIn:
2
0000-1111-2222-3333 is blocked.
[BILLING] User 8891 charged 50 USD on 3847-5610-2938-4756
testCases.testOut:
[CARD_REDACTED] is blocked.
[BILLING] User 8891 charged 50 USD on [CARD_REDACTED]

testCases.title: Test 3: Non-alphanumeric boundaries
testCases.testIn:
7
php?my_token=abc&token=valid123_extra
ERROR Negative balance on -8291-3849-1029-4820
TRACE Range overflow on 8291-3849-1029-4820-
TRACE: req_id=42;card=7482-1928-3746-5019;token=AdminPass99;
DEBUG /audit?token=token_beta9
2026-09-08T09:03:00Z: [token=SecretApiKey]; card: 0093-5648-7367-2174!
LOG 1234#1111-2222-3333-4444#5678 END
testCases.testOut:
php?my_token=[TOKEN_REDACTED]&token=[TOKEN_REDACTED]_extra
ERROR Negative balance on -[CARD_REDACTED]
TRACE Range overflow on [CARD_REDACTED]-
TRACE: req_id=42;card=[CARD_REDACTED];token=[TOKEN_REDACTED];
DEBUG /audit?token=[TOKEN_REDACTED]_beta9
2026-09-08T09:03:00Z: [token=[TOKEN_REDACTED]]; card: [CARD_REDACTED]!
LOG 1234#[CARD_REDACTED]#5678 END

testCases.title: Validator 3
testCases.testIn:
7
url/endpoint;token=Key999!done
ERROR Reverting state to -4756-1029-3847-5610
TRACE Trailing dash in 4756-1029-3847-5610-
DEBUG Payload: mode=live;cnum=2938-4756-1029-3847;token=LiveKey987;

2049-06-04T07:00:05Z: <token=AdminPass99> and {4146-3499-5862-8507}
INFO 9999/4756-1029-3847-5610/1111 DONE
testCases.testOut:

ERROR Reverting state to -[CARD_REDACTED]

DEBUG Payload: mode=live;cnum=[CARD_REDACTED];token=[TOKEN_REDACTED];

2049-06-04T07:00:05Z: <token=[TOKEN_REDACTED]> and {[CARD_REDACTED]}
INFO 9999/[CARD_REDACTED]/1111 DONE

lastVersion.statementHTML:
Goal

As a SecOps engineer, you must ensure that sensitive data never leaks into application logs.

For the purposes of this task, tokens are defined as being bounded by non-alphanumeric characters or the beginning or end of the line.

Inspect a stream of server log lines and sanitize all occurrences of the following two patterns, subject to the overlapping rule:

1. Credit card numbers
Exactly four consecutive tokens, each consisting of exactly 4 digits and joined by -, form a credit card number and should be replaced with [CARD_REDACTED].

2. API token
A token token (case-sensitive), immediately followed by = and another token (the value) consisting of one or more alphanumeric characters, forms an API token. Redact the value token only, replacing it with [TOKEN_REDACTED].

Overlapping rule
Overlapping occurrences of a single pattern should not be considered to fit the pattern and should remain unchanged. For example, this applies to:
• Five or more consecutive tokens, each consisting of exactly 4 digits and joined by -.
• token= appears consecutively two or more times.

If token= is immediately followed by a token consisting of exactly 4 digits, treat that 4-digit token as the API-token value. This takes precedence over any credit-card matching that might otherwise involve that token. Continue processing the remaining text after redacting that token.

All other log characters must remain untouched.
Input
Line 1: An integer N for the number of log lines.
Next N lines: A string line representing a raw log entry.
Output
N lines: The sanitized log entries.
Constraints
1 ≤ N ≤ 10
line contains between 1 and 100 printable ASCII characters.
Example
Input
4
[SYSTEM] Server running on port 8080 with 0 errors.
[TRANSFER] Moved funds from 8291-3849-1029-4820 to 5731-4921-5829-1039 confirmed.
192.168.1.1 - GET /auth?token=abC123XyZ HTTP/1.1
2023-10-01 12:00:00 INFO: Session initiated, token=validToken123 login success
Output
[SYSTEM] Server running on port 8080 with 0 errors.
[TRANSFER] Moved funds from [CARD_REDACTED] to [CARD_REDACTED] confirmed.
192.168.1.1 - GET /auth?token=[TOKEN_REDACTED] HTTP/1.1
2023-10-01 12:00:00 INFO: Session initiated, token=[TOKEN_REDACTED] login success
